# fauxidc

> fauxidc is a small OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect mock server for local development and integration tests: one static binary with a login page, signed tokens, a Test API, Injected failures and a debugger page. Never use it in production.

## Docs

- [Start in 60 seconds](README.md#start-in-60-seconds): Docker, the release binary, the discovery URL and a first token
- [Recipes](README.md#recipes): SPA with PKCE, backend with a client secret, machine-to-machine, tokens in tests, random host ports, provider outages, agents
- [Configuration summary](README.md#configuration): config sources and the config command
- [Test API summary](README.md#test-api): the `/_mock/` routes and the dashboard
- [Templates summary](README.md#templates): custom pages and the Custom user template
- [Debugger summary](README.md#debugger): decode a JWT or run a login flow
- [TLS summary](README.md#tls): the optional `tls` feature
- [Hot reload summary](README.md#hot-reload): config file polling and SIGHUP
- [Conformance](README.md#conformance): the OpenID conformance suite in CI
- [Not supported](README.md#not-supported): non-goals and current limits
- [Configuration reference](docs/configuration.md): sources, Zero config, Docker, examples, Strict and Lenient mode, signing keys
- [Test API reference](docs/test-api.md): token minting, key rotation, Injected failures, Users, Clients, config view, state reset, config reload, Request log, the dashboard at `/_mock/`
- [Testcontainers guide](docs/testcontainers.md): `GenericContainer` setup, wait strategy, random host port, Spring Boot, tokens from Java
- [Features reference](docs/features.md): the login page view (`show_user_list`, `GET`/`PUT /_mock/{issuer-id}/login`), Sessions, hot reload, debugger, TLS, token exchange, `private_key_jwt`
- [Templates reference](docs/templates.md): the template context (version 3) and the stylesheet
- [Spec](docs/spec.md): the full behavior reference

## Config

- [JSON Schema](schema/fauxidc.schema.json): every config key, draft 2020-12
- [generic.toml](examples/generic.toml): default paths, web, SPA and service Clients
- [auth0.toml](examples/auth0.toml): Auth0-style paths and logout alias
- [okta.toml](examples/okta.toml): Okta-style `/v1/*` paths
- [keycloak.toml](examples/keycloak.toml): Keycloak-style paths and realm roles
- [entra.toml](examples/entra.toml): Entra-style claims
- [cognito.toml](examples/cognito.toml): Cognito-style paths and claims
- [docker-compose.yml](examples/docker-compose.yml): the published image with `auth0.toml`

## Agent skill

- [fauxidc skill](skills/fauxidc/SKILL.md): start fauxidc, write a config, mint tokens, inject failures, read the Request log, use the debugger, common pitfalls
- [fauxidc-setup skill](skills/fauxidc-setup/SKILL.md): add fauxidc to an app project, with a config, a compose file, a wrapper script and a README from templates
